about: Where the lord of a house sits decides where that house affairs get played out. The Lagna lord is covered for all twelve houses; beyond that this file holds the placements that carry a named classical judgement. The engine also states every lordship as derived geometry, so a house is never left unaddressed just because no rule exists for it yet.

rules.says: The Lagna lord sits in its own house: self-possessed and physically resilient, with a life largely steered from the inside.
The Lagna lord goes to the second: the person is bound up with earning and with family resources, and identity is measured partly in what has been accumulated.
The Lagna lord goes to the third: self-made through effort, competitive by instinct, and closely involved with siblings.
The Lagna lord goes to the fourth: home, land and the mother are central to the life, and the person is at their strongest on familiar ground.
The Lagna lord goes to the fifth: identity is invested in children, in creative work, or in whatever the person considers worth being right about.
The Lagna lord falls into the sixth: the person is defined partly by what they are up against. Health and debt need watching, and the capacity for service is real.
The Lagna lord goes to the seventh: the self is completed by the other. Partnership is not optional in this chart, and travel or relocation often follows it.
The Lagna lord falls into the eighth: the life changes shape abruptly more than once, and the person is drawn to what other people leave alone.
The Lagna lord goes to the ninth: fortunate, and principled in a way that is load-bearing rather than decorative. The father or a teacher shapes the direction taken.
The Lagna lord goes to the tenth: the person is their work. Status is achieved rather than inherited, and idleness is genuinely uncomfortable.
The Lagna lord goes to the eleventh: gains come through their own initiative and through a network they built themselves.
The Lagna lord falls into the twelfth: energy goes outward into foreign places, private work or things given away. Vitality needs protecting.

rules.name: Harsha yoga (Vipreet Raja yoga)
rules.says: The lord of the sixth is itself displaced into a house of difficulty: the classical reversal, where adversity undoes itself. Enemies, illness and debt lose their grip, often after one bad stretch that turns out to have been the turning point.

rules.name: Sarala yoga (Vipreet Raja yoga)
rules.says: The lord of the eighth is displaced into another difficult house: longevity improves, sudden reversals lose their force, and the person survives situations that should have cost them more.

rules.name: Vimala yoga (Vipreet Raja yoga)
rules.says: The lord of the twelfth is displaced into another difficult house: expenditure stays under control, independence comes early, and the person is harder to ruin than they look.

rules.name: Dharma-Karmadhipati yoga
rules.says: The lords of the ninth and tenth sit together: what the person believes and what the person does for a living are the same thing. One of the strongest signatures for a career with standing behind it.

rules.name: Lord of gain in a difficult house
rules.says: The lord of the eleventh is displaced into a house of difficulty: income is irregular and tends to be consumed by obligations as it arrives.
The lord of work comes to the Lagna: the profession attaches itself to the person rather than the other way round, and reputation precedes them into a room.
The lord of fortune occupies its own house: the ninth works without obstruction, which shows as good luck that other people find implausible.

rules.name: Lord of partnership in a difficult house
rules.says: The lord of the seventh is displaced into a house of difficulty: partnership is strained by circumstance rather than by feeling, often through distance, illness or work.
